# Copper Scroll Column 9 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all lines in Copper Scroll Column 9 (treasure locations 37-42) where the three translators diverged, along with SOPHIA's resolution.

---

## 9:1 — tomb under/beneath + colonnades/colonnade

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the tomb which is under the colonnades" |
| LOGOS | "the tomb beneath the colonnades" |
| PNEUMA | "the burial chamber beneath the colonnade" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS's concise "the tomb beneath the colonnades." PNEUMA's "burial chamber" is interpretive; plural "colonnades" matches the Hebrew.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 9:7 — ingots/bars

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "sixty-five ingots" — consistent with earlier usage |
| LOGOS | "sixty-five ingots" — same |
| PNEUMA | "sixty-five bars" — simplified |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "ingots" per EMET/LOGOS for consistency throughout the scroll.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---

## 9:10 — near/beside/by the carob tree

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "near the carob tree" |
| LOGOS | "beside the carob tree" |
| PNEUMA | "by the carob tree" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's "near" as the most neutral spatial preposition for the Hebrew etsel.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 9:13 — in the mouth / at the opening / at the mouth

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "In the mouth of the spring" |
| LOGOS | "At the opening of the spring" |
| PNEUMA | "At the mouth of the spring" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted PNEUMA's "At the mouth of the spring" — "at" is better than "in" for a spring's opening, and "mouth" preserves the literal pi.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of PNEUMA.

---

## 9:15-16 — offering phrasing

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "vessels of silver and vessels of gold of offering" |
| LOGOS | "vessels of silver and vessels of gold, consecrated as offerings" |
| PNEUMA | "gold and silver vessels set apart as offerings" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's construction "vessels of silver and vessels of gold of offering" — preserves the Hebrew word order and the repeated "vessels of" pattern.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 9:17 — total/totaling/altogether

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "six hundred talents total" |
| LOGOS | "totaling six hundred talents" |
| PNEUMA | "six hundred talents altogether" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's "six hundred talents total" — most concise rendering matching the terse Hebrew inventory style.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

*Total disagreements in Column 9: 6*
